coordinates.perspective_camera_note: Canonical helper hero camera in +X/-Y/+Z quadrant, reused as perspective and preview; numeric direction recorded in exact-GLB evidence.

concept.reason: Real skull plus research-group existing reconstruction sufficient.

classification: Sauropterygia, Placodontia, Cyamodontoidea, Placochelyidae; not turtle
scope: Whole original animal, armoured body and sharply tapering toothless snout tip.
specimen_basis: Holotype Ob.2323/Vt.3 skull photo by Istvan Fozy on Hungarian Dinosaur Expedition site. Armour fragments rather than a complete measured carapace.

scale.basis: Sea Rex educator guide2010 page14 authored Jouve/Vincent/Bardet; reconstruction estimates, not exact complete specimen measurements.
scale.ratio_basis: PE2010 table1 explicitly interpretation from Jaekel1907 plate10, NOT fossil measurement.

diagnostic_targets: Narrow pointed triangular tapering rostrum contrasting broad rear skull; no broad square Henodus mouth.
Low oval elongated armour, longer than wide, with subtle polygonal nodules; not a high modern turtle dome.
Four short laterally spread limbs with conservative webbing, neck short, tapering tail retained.
No teeth at snout tip; posterior crushing teeth remain, closed mouth allowed.
Whole organism, no skull-only substitution, no fossil slab.
uncertainties: Large portions of postcranial material lost; carapace outline is reconstruction.
Skin, colour, webbing extent, live body volume inferred; artwork not direct fossil evidence.
Only front snout toothless, not entire mouth.
acceptance_checks: Pointed triangular head evident front/top and profile.
Low longer-than-wide oval armour clearly unlike Henodus broad transverse carapace.
Four attached limbs plus tail and closed jaw, coherent whole body.
handoff_contract: Same dir maker QA; maker fixedhash COMPLETE stops; root async backup local-first integration; no maker upload cleanup.
origin: Identity root at centre of four-foot contact; lowest foot contact z=0. Interpretative benthic pose.
material_profile: Five matte, opaque, original palette-only PBR materials; no embedded images or source-only shaders.
